rule_set.name: Baseline Vastu rule set (3 x 3 grid)
rule_set.description: Starter rule set for the MVP. Seeded as approved so the demo works; a Vastu practitioner should review every rule and remedy before production use.
rule_set.disclaimer: Vastu Shastra is a traditional system of architectural guidance. The findings in this report apply the rules of the selected Vastu rule set to the verified floor plan. They are recommendations from that methodology, not scientific, structural, legal or financial advice.
